title: Bias in the Ear of the Listener: Assessing Sensitivity in Audio Language Models Across Linguistic, Demographic, and Positional Variations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating variations in model accuracy, entropy, Average Pairwise Entropy Shift (APES), and Fleiss' Kappa when spoken multiple-choice questions are presented in different languages (English, Chinese, Korean) and various regional accents.
Measuring stability and performance differences (accuracy, entropy, APES, Fleiss' Kappa) when identical spoken questions are delivered by male versus female synthesized voices.

Evaluating structural selection bias by measuring changes in model predictions and confidence when the presentation order of multiple-choice options is altered (e.g., original vs. reversed) in the spoken audio.
Comparing model entropy and robustness metrics between Culturally Sensitive (CS) and Culturally Agnostic (CA) question subsets under various speech perturbations.
